name: transformable
description: Everything that has position, rotation, scale and opacity.
help: Anything with position, rotation, scale and opacity.

x.help: X position of the pivot, relative to the parent.
x.description: X position of the pivot, relative to the parent.

y.help: Y position of the pivot, relative to the parent (grows downward).
y.description: Y position of the pivot, relative to the parent (grows downward).

rotation.help: Rotation in degrees around the pivot; positive = clockwise.
rotation.description: Rotation in degrees around the pivot; positive = clockwise.

opacity.help: Opacity from 0 (invisible) to 1; multiplied by the parent one.
opacity.description: Opacity from 0 (invisible) to 1; multiplied by the parent's.

visible.help: When off, neither it nor its children are drawn.
visible.description: If false, neither it nor its children are drawn.

locked.help: Locked: it and its children can't be picked or changed on the canvas, so you can work around it. Still editable from Layers and the inspector. Doesn't change how it looks.
locked.description: Editor lock: when true, neither it nor its children can be selected or moved from the canvas (the user works around it without touching it by accident). It does not change how it looks or how it animates. It is the user's: the AI does not change a locked layer or its children unless asked, and does not unlock it.

bone.help: Bone it is bound to (layer binding): in a pose, it and its children follow the bone. Only bones of its skeleton.
bone.description: Bone it is attached to (layer binding): in a pose, the object and its children follow the bone by how much it moved relative to the setup. In the setup nothing changes. It can only be a bone of the skeleton that contains it (the nearest one). Without bone, it follows its parent's bone; if no ancestor has one, it stays still.
